findings.title: Signed-in pass-through on a protected page is never tested
findings.detail: Only a signed-in user on a page that is neither a sign-in page nor a patient page (e.g. `/home`, `/staff/schedule`) reaches this final `NextResponse.next()`. That is the branch the refactor rewrote (`!isPublicRoute` → `!isAuthPage`), and none of the 10 tests in `src/proxy.test.ts` covers it, so a guard that sent every protected page to `/login` would still pass the whole suite. Fix: add a test that sets `sessionHolder.current = signedInSession` and calls `expectPassThrough(await visit('/staff/schedule'))` and `expectPassThrough(await visit('/home'))`, and in the same change add a check that an anonymous visitor on `/register` passes through.
